description: An input or textarea with icons, text or buttons attached, all inside one field.

text.title: With Text
text.description: A text prefix or suffix, such as "Rp" or an email domain.

button.title: With Button
button.description: A small button inside the field, such as copy code or show password.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: An addon below the textarea, such as a character counter.

invalid.title: Error
invalid.description: aria-invalid on the input turns the whole group red.

parts.group: Wrapper that draws the border, focus and error states.
parts.input: The input inside the group (no border of its own).
parts.textarea: The textarea inside the group (no border of its own).
parts.addon: Extra content: icon, text or button.
parts.button: A small button inside an addon.

props.align: Addon position: left, right, above or below the input.
props.size: Size of the button inside the group.
